node.statement: Amplified adjoint symmetry entrywise: for X=[x_ij] in M_n tensor A, matrix involution and canonical amplification give (T_n(X)^dagger)_ij=T(x_ji)^dagger=U(x_ji^dagger), while (U_n(X^dagger))_ij=U((X^dagger)_ij)=U(x_ji^dagger); hence T_n(X)^dagger=U_n(X^dagger).
